title: Alljoined1
description: Alljoined1 is a 64-channel EEG dataset comprising neural responses from eight healthy adults viewing 10,000 natural images presented via rapid serial visual presentation (RSVP). The dataset includes approximately 46,080 epochs recorded at 512 Hz using a BioSemi ActiveTwo system, with stimuli drawn from the Natural Scenes Dataset and MS-COCO. This resource is designed to support EEG-to-image decoding research and includes both raw BDF recordings and preprocessed, epoched derivatives.
methods_description: EEG data were recorded from 8 right-handed adults (6 male, 2 female; mean age 22 ± 0.64 years) using a 64-channel BioSemi ActiveTwo system with Ag/AgCl sintered electrodes positioned according to the International 10-20 system. Signals were digitized at 512 Hz with 24-bit A/D conversion and referenced to CMS/DRL. Participants performed an oddball detection task during rapid serial visual presentation (RSVP) of natural images (300 ms stimulus, 300 ms blank screen, 0-50 ms jitter). Preprocessing included 0.5-125 Hz band-pass filtering, 60 Hz notch filtering, FastICA (95% variance retained), epoching (-50 to 600 ms), AutoReject artifact rejection, baseline correction, and average re-referencing.
